# HoverController

> Tracks pointer enter/leave with configurable delays, dispatching `native:hover-start` and `native:hover-end`.

## Constructor

```ts
new HoverController(host: HTMLElement, options?: HoverOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `delay` | `number` | no |  |
| `leaveDelay` | `number` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `native:hover-start` | `{ pointerType }` |
| `native:hover-end` | `{ pointerType }` |

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `attach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `detach()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { HoverController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new HoverController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
